note: The head coach of record of every major-college team-season from 1869 to 1935, read from Wikipedia's "<Program> football coach navbox" templates (CC BY-SA 4.0; each row's receipt is the template's own line, fetched 2026-10-22). This file is an adaptation of those templates and carries their license. A row's coach is null where the navbox lists two coaches in turn (a mid-season change nothing here can place at a game) or co-coaches; a season the navbox calls "No coach" has no row. The build (scripts/build-ledgers.mjs) credits a coach with every game of his team's season; from 1936 the coaches come from CFBD's rows resolved game by game in College Football Streak King's payload instead.
